senses.gloss:
इच्छक a. Wishing, desiring &c.
--कः
1 (In Arith.) The sum sought.
--2 N. of a tree.

इच्छा [इष् भावे श]
1 Wish, desire,
inclination of mind, will; इच्छया
according to one's desire, at will.
--2
Willingness.
--3 (In Math.) A
question or problem.
--4 (In gram.)
The form of the Desiderative.
--Comp.
--दानं fulfilment of a wish.
--निवृत्तिः f. suppression of desire,
indifference to worldly desires.
--फलं the solution of a question or
problem.
--रतं desired sports,
favourite pastimes; Me. 89.
--वसु a.
‘possessing wealth according to
wish’, epithet of Kubera.
--संपद् f.
fulfilment of one's wishes.
इच्छकः N. of a tree, the citron.

इच्छत् pres. p. Wishing, desirous,
willing; अनिच्छतोपि तस्य against his
will.

इच्छु a. Wishing, desirous;
usually in comp.
